_authority: L45 (owner, 2026-10-05): the NOVIKONTAS classroom system's own rules for a course folder - from tablet-system-win/COURSE_FACTORY_PROMPT.md ('Give this whole file to the course factory at the start of a new course') and the admin panel's importer, admin/package-core.mjs, of which course-tablet-publisher/vendor/package-core.mjs is a byte-identical copy. Where any older layout rule in this factory differs (L43's module names, the presentation file, the instructor notes file), THIS wins: it is what the classroom reads. scripts/check_course_package.py checks a folder against it and then runs the importer itself.
where: course\modules\ in the work folder (L44) IS the course folder that is added to the classroom: COURSE.html, _course_shell\, module01\ ... moduleNN\. to_review\ and working_claude\ stay beside it and are never uploaded.

layout.COURSE.html: the course start page; its <title> is the course title - and the course ID is made from that title, so the title never changes once the course is added. Optional <meta name="description" content="...">. Instructor-only.
layout._course_shell/course_map.js: window.COURSE_MAP = [{"code":"module01","title":"Gas tankers","entry":"presentation/index.html"}, ...]; - the module order and titles, read as data, never run. The factory always writes it.
layout.moduleNN/: two digits, taught in that order: module01, module02 ... the final assessment is the last one (L34).
layout.moduleNN/presentation/index.html: the instructor's deck (projector). The system finds a module by this file. Instructor-only.
layout.moduleNN/START_HERE.html: instructor-only; opens the presentation straight away (L43).
layout.moduleNN/START_HERE_EXTENDED.html: instructor-only; a button for the presentation, every task, the module check, the plan, the handout (L43).
layout.moduleNN/tasks/<code>_<slug>.html: one page per trainee task (a self-check is one page with all its questions). No tasks/index.html: the trainee never sees a task list (L35).
layout.moduleNN/assessment/check.html: the module check (trainee-facing). The final assessment: assessment/final.html in the last module.
layout.moduleNN/assessment/check_answer_key.htm: answers and marking - instructor-only by its name.
layout.moduleNN/handout/index.html: optional reading the trainee may open at any time.
layout.moduleNN/instructor/: the module plan, practical cards - instructor-only by its folder name.
layout.moduleNN/assets/: every picture, model, film, style, font and script the module uses (L43: the module needs nothing outside its own folder).

names.no_spaces: never a space in a folder or file name - pictures copied from the old course are renamed
names.task_file: <code lower-case>_<title as a slug>.html, e.g. sc1_keeping_the_cargo_liquid.html - and the name never changes in later versions: results are filed under it
names.codes: the code on the slide (data-activity), in the page title and in the result is the same: SC1, SC2 ... for the self-checks of a module, MC for its module check, P1, P2 ... for work in the room, FA for the final assessment

limits.pictures: JPEG or WebP, 1600 px on the long side is plenty; a 3D model or a film over 6 MB does not import - shorten, compress or split it
limits.offline: no http(s) source, script, style or font; every link relative and inside the course; no Google Fonts - every font has a system fallback

deck.slide: <section class="slide" id="s07" data-title="..." data-kind="Theory" data-day="1" data-block="A1" data-cue="...">
deck.data_cue: the instructor notes of that slide (2.18.1: short points) - the instructor's panel shows them; the projector never does. This, not a .md file, is how the notes reach the panel: the importer skips .md files.
deck.task_slide:
data-kind="Task" data-activity="SC1" data-task-href="../tasks/sc1_keeping_the_cargo_liquid.html" data-title="SC1 — Keeping the cargo liquid", with

SC1

...

- the panel shows ▶ Start and opens exactly that page on every trainee tablet (L35's OPEN TASK)
deck.room_slide: work on paper or in the room: data-kind="Task" data-activity="P1", NO data-task-href, data-link-hint="Work in pairs at the simulator"
deck.navigation: the visible slide has class 'slide active'; ArrowRight / ArrowLeft move, each press shows the next .frag first; F may go fullscreen with document.documentElement.requestFullscreen(); no countdown of the deck's own - the classroom runs the timer and hides .act-timer / .act-note on the projector

task_page.viewport: Android WebView, landscape, about 1280 x 800 CSS px, touch only (L42's numbers apply: 56 px controls, 18 px question text)
task_page.title: <title>SC1 — Keeping the cargo liquid</title> - the code, then the title
task_page.standalone: works on its own - never depends on the deck or another page
task_page.result: show the result on the page, then report it ONCE: window.parent.postMessage({type:'gb-task-done', code:'SC1', title:'Keeping the cargo liquid', ok:7, total:9, head:'', items:[{t:'1. ...', ok:true}, ...], answered:8, of:9, timeout:false}, '*')
task_page.head: self-check: '' (no pass mark). Module check and final assessment: 'PASSED' or 'NOT PASSED', with the pass mark stated on the page and applied there (owner, 2026-10-05: a module check can be passed or not passed - it is for the trainee and the instructor to know whether the module was understood, not an official grade; only the final assessment is the official one)
task_page.timer: the instructor's timer arrives as {type:'gb-timer', endsAt, remaining}; at 0 the page marks what was done and reports it with timeout:true. The page never shows a countdown of its own.
task_page.no_retry_in_class: after the report, no 'Start again' inside the classroom frame - one opening, one result. Retries only outside it (window.parent === window).
task_page.answers_hidden: never put the answers in a trainee page's source where they can be read without doing the task; marking sheets are separate instructor-only files

instructor_only.trainee_copy: only files in tasks/, handout/, documents/, assets/, assessment/ (and _course_shell/course_bridge.js, gb_tokens.css) reach the trainee tablet - and never one of the instructor-only names
instructor_only.rule: a trainee page (tasks/, assessment/check.html, handout/) never links to an instructor-only file - the link would not open on the tablet; a 'back to the guide' link to START_HERE.html is the commonest mistake

skipped_by_the_importer: folders starting with _ (except _course_shell), test_..., knowledge_base, source_files; files .md .txt .py .zip .tgz .bak ... - so nothing of the factory's own may sit inside course\modules\, and nothing the course needs may be one of these
versions: the course ID is fixed when the course is first added; an update is the same ID and a higher version - 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 for fixes, 1.1.0 for new content. A task page keeps its file name across versions.
before_handover: every module has moduleNN/presentation/index.html and every .slide has data-title
every slide that sends trainees to their tablets has data-task-href pointing at a page that exists
every task page reports one gb-task-done with ok, total and items; checks also report head
no external URL, no CDN script, no file over 6 MB
no working folders inside the course folder (or they start with _)
no trainee page links to START_HERE.html or any other instructor-only file
every page works by touch alone at 1280 x 800 landscape - in a browser by a colleague, on the tablet by the owner at the end (L39)
